sections_reviewed: Section 1: industrial delay guarantees and forwarding/scheduling
Section 4: per-packet deadline and origination-time metadata
verified_title: Packet Delivery Deadline Time in the Routing Header for IPv6 over Low-Power Wireless Personal Area Networks (6LoWPANs)
method_summary: Defines an interoperable compressed routing header containing packet deadline and optional origination-time delta for constrained synchronized networks. A sender flag controls dropping after deadline expiry.
evidence_and_limits: Protocol specification, not a learned hazard estimator or a benchmark demonstrating model superiority. Primarily synchronized 6LoWPAN/6TiSCH; does not prove arbitrary Wi-Fi or 5G implementations provide these measurements.
